unlisted_practices: Traceable clinician-audited training supervision provenance (Clinical Trust Signals) linking reasoning instances to clinician rubric scores and edit histories
Domain-tailored safety and ethics alignment fine-tuning of a medical LLM
Red-team stress testing used to inform model alignment

screen.reason: The paper introduces a new fine-tuned model (SafeMed-R1) trained with clinical trust signals and red-team alignment, evaluating it on benchmarks, adversarial safety prompts, and clinical vignettes rather than testing an organizational deployment practice or runtime guardrail on an existing tool.
